summary: Results Center new rules tested end-to-end. Backend: test_results_center_iter210.py rewritten to be self-seeding (own TEST_ courses + own marks on MAIN course 6a773c33d51592e96b39c174, teardown removes rc_marks/rc_log/rc_sheets created in run + rc_settings if absent before). 20 tests: 19 pass, 1 fail (real bug: clearing coursework of a not-eligible student who has a second_exam mark is allowed -> orphaned second mark). Verified: first_exam/second_exam before lock (rejected only for missing coursework 'ارصد سعي' / not eligible / not in second; accepted otherwise, incl. absence-based not-eligible student on second), eligibility-flip guard both directions + non-flipping change allowed, Excel import add-only (status 'exists', marks unchanged, empty cells never wipe, coursework import also add-only, manual edit still changes), lock still needs full coursework, publish still blocked when a course is unlocked. Frontend (admin, 1920x1080): course search by name & code filters cards + rc-courses-count '(من 13)', search-empty + clear button, page sizes 12/24/48/all, pager prev/next/info (13 courses -> 2 pages at 12), sheet open before lock: first-tab inputs for eligible students, second-tab input for not-eligible student, save works, flip error shown inline in row, import modal preview shows 'موجودة — تُركت' rows + rejected reasons, commit disabled when ok=0.

minor.issue: Clearing coursework (set to empty) of a NOT-eligible student who already has a second_exam mark is saved. Eligibility stays False->False so the flip guard does not fire, but in_second becomes False (requires coursework != None) and the second_exam mark is orphaned (result 'بانتظار السعي'). Same would apply to exceptional chain. Fix in _save: also block when val is None and any exam field exists (e.g. 'احذف درجة الدور أولاً'), or compare in_second/eligible + coursework-presence instead of eligible only.

ui_bugs.issue: mark-wait-cw-{sid} is unreachable in first/second/exceptional tabs: rowsForTab filters first=eligible, second=in_second, exceptional=pass2===false — all require coursework, so students without coursework never appear there. Requested 'بلا سعي' hint never renders. Either show all students (with read-only + 'بلا سعي') in those tabs or drop the dead code.

issues: 'exists' badge text duplicates wording: 'موجودة — تُركت: للطالب درجة مرصودة — تُركت كما هي (عدّلها يدوياً إن لزم)' — shorten the backend reason or the label.

action_items: Block clearing coursework (value empty) when the student has any exam mark (first/second/exceptional) — test_main_clear_coursework_with_second_exam_blocked
Make 'بلا سعي' visible (or remove dead code) — students without coursework are filtered out of exam tabs
Optional: dedupe 'تُركت' wording in import exists badge
critical_code_review_comments: _save flip guard only compares eligible; should also consider coursework becoming None (in_second depends on cw is not None).

Before-lock exam entry: if attendance status later changes (student becomes candidate/deprived) after a first_exam mark is entered, eligibility flips with no guard — first_exam mark silently ignored. Consider surfacing this in sheet/publish preview.
Template endpoint uses _allowed(field, r, True) — fine, but for coursework it lists all students regardless of lock; ok.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 low-priority unreachable indicator)

seed_data_creation: Test-created only; all cleaned. Temporary UI seed on MAIN course (coursework/first/second for 3 students) deleted by student ids; rc_* collections back to 0 docs, rc_settings 0.

rca of the issue: Clear-coursework orphan: _save computes new eligibility with m2['coursework']=None -> eligible False; old eligible False -> equal -> no block. compute() sets in_second = (cw is not None and not eligible) or pass1 is False -> False, so second_exam ignored. Repro: coursework 10 -> second_exam 60 -> PUT coursework ''. Mitigation: block if val is None and any of first/second/exceptional exam not None.
